title: similarity
description: Visual similarity between quality segments, written by scripts/similarity.py once per workspace: one image embedding per segment and every pair whose cosine similarity reaches the threshold. The director uses the pairs to refuse near-duplicate shots; the embeddings allow a different threshold without re-extracting frames. Frames are never written to disk.

embedding.description: L2-normalised segment embedding, rounded to 4 decimals

backend.description: embedding backend: mobilenet = MobileNetV2 ONNX through cv2.dnn, hist = handcrafted HSV/gradient/luma histograms (offline fallback)

model.description: model artifact used by the backend, e.g. mobilenetv2-12.onnx

threshold.description: pairs at or above this cosine similarity are listed

segments.description: one entry per quality segment that contributed frames, in clip order

pairs.description: every pair with cosine similarity >= threshold, most similar first

llm_cost_usd.description: always 0: this tool calls no model service
